ops.body: PR169 and parent167 are merged at f78c2f53. Official v0.75.0 release41769470793 compiled all four CLI targets but macOS smoke failed because the fresh fixture had no managed authority. CI lint exposed lost operation contexts and checked-byte conversion issues. Follow-up PR195 preserves the exact serialized object types, threads cancellation through metadata publication/ref-count reclamation and scoped object readers, and explicitly reindexes the release fixture. Hosted helper-driver oracle passed on initial merged source; baseline helper cost rejected the old path. Candidate cost still running; no installed recovery claim. Local MCP clients remain protected and pending separately.
